Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request was successful. E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful. DCM_E_PENDING: Request is not yet finished. Further call(s) required to finish. Description This function requests to the application to reset an IOControl to default value. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Dcm_Externals.h
